points.description: States that a static array is initialized only once when the function is called (equivalently, it is not reinitialized on every function call). Accept wording such as 'initialized a single time' or 'initialized once at the time of the function call'.
points.partial_credit: Part marks for giving only the one-time initialization or only the function-call timing.

levels.says: Says a static array is initialized only once, but does not mention that this occurs when the function is called or does not make the one-time/function-call contrast clear.
Says a static array is initialized when the function is called, but does not state that this happens only once or that it is not reinitialized on each call.

rubric.notes: Full marks require saying that a static array is initialized only once when the function is called, or an equivalent statement that it is not reinitialized on every call. Part marks are given for stating only the one-time initialization or only the function-call timing. Answers saying static arrays are initialized every time, or that do not address initialization timing, earn no marks.
